# INAS Documentation

> Official Japanese documentation for starting, operating, and maintaining INAS. General-user guides are placed first; implementation details are isolated under developer documentation.

## Start here

- [To the people who use INAS](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/start/why-inas/): the purpose and values behind INAS
- [How INAS works](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/start/overview/): the screen, Hub, and field equipment in plain language
- [Choose how to start](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/start/choose-path/): company-provided equipment or technician-led self-build
- [Prepare Wi-Fi](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/start/network/): the Wi-Fi name, password, placement, and connection check
- [Company-provided hardware](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/start/provided-hardware/): a three-step appliance-like setup flyer
- [Safety](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/start/safety/): illustrated placement, manual shutoff, short test, and emergency stop

## Daily operation

- [Daily checks](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/operate/daily/): field status, device state, work, and watering
- [AI cultivation plans and work proposals](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/operate/ai-calendar/): create, compare, accept, or reject AI suggestions

## General-user configuration

- [Screen settings guide](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/configure/settings/): actual Hub screenshots with each user-facing setting explained
- [Fields and devices](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/configure/fields-devices/): field hierarchy, automatic device recognition, Local Hub and Edge Gateway scenarios, and success confirmation
- [Watering settings](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/configure/watering/): visual guides for schedules, split watering, and soil-moisture conditions

## Troubleshooting and support

- [Troubleshooting index](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/troubleshoot/)
- [Device offline](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/troubleshoot/device-offline/)
- [Watering does not start](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/troubleshoot/watering/)
- [Device settings are not applied](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/troubleshoot/config/)
- [Discord Community](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/community/)

## Developer documentation

- [Developer entry point](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/technical/): architecture, Local Hub build, device development, and administrator operation
- [Technical architecture](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/technical/architecture/): Local Hub, Edge Gateway, three communication routes, system components, and cloudflared responsibility
- [Networking details](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/technical/networking/): mDNS, DHCP reservation, MQTT, OTA, ports, Cloudflare, constraints, and diagnostics
- [Administrator app settings](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/technical/app-settings/): AI, notifications, Instagram, and infrastructure status with screenshots
- [Electrical and irrigation safety](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/technical/hardware-safety/): voltage, output circuits, protection, enclosure, and acceptance tests
- [Self-build setup journey](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/start/quickstart/): purchase through field acceptance
- [Prepare Raspberry Pi](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/hub/raspberry-pi/)
- [Install Local Hub](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/hub/install/)
- [Cloudflare remote UI access](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/hub/cloudflare/)
- [Update and backup](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/hub/update-backup/)
- [Device catalog](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/devices/)
- [WTR single-channel watering device](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/devices/wtr/)
- [WRS RS485 watering device](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/devices/wrs/)
- [SOI and ENV sensors](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/devices/sensors/)
- [Device setting keys](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/configure/settings-reference/)
- [Runtime Config protocol](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/reference/runtime-config/)
- [Firmware and OTA](https://docs.inas-technologies.com/operate/firmware/)

The company-provided hardware specification is still pending. General users should follow the plain-language start, operation, and configuration pages. Implementation terms, raw keys, network constraints, and administrator-only settings belong in the developer section. Never disclose credentials, private hostnames, or production device identifiers when requesting support.
